question: On Robinhood Chain (chain 4663), during the last 1 hour (3600 seconds before the request), did any block include a transaction whose type is not 0x6a (the ArbOS internal type)? Answer true or false.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 1 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.source: Use JSON-RPC at https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com for chain 4663; verify eth_chainId.
definitions.metric: Fetch every block with eth_getBlockByNumber(number,true). Ignore transactions with type 0x6a, which every block carries. Return true iff some block has a remaining transaction; false only after complete enumeration.
